## Definition of Done

- [ ] The scope matches the phase spec; any deviation is explained in the notes.
- [ ] CI is green.
- [ ] Tests cover the new behaviour.
- [ ] Notes and ADRs are written, and the indexes are updated (`docs/adr/README.md`, `docs/milestone-1/notes/README.md`, the plan's phase overview).

- [ ] Independent implementation: nothing is copied from OpenFlexure's code, styles, assets or text ([ADR-0002](https://github.com/lucaswewa/microscope/blob/main/docs/adr/0002-independent-implementation-of-openflexure-inspired-behaviour.md)).

This pull request is merged only after the project owner approves it. The next phase starts after the merge.
